# PrivacyFold — Client-Side Document & File Tools (no uploads)
> 72 tools that run inside the browser tab. Two embed a WebAssembly engine (libheif for HEIC, sql.js for SQLite);
> the other 70 are plain JavaScript using Canvas, Web Crypto and the File API. Files and text never leave the device,
> there is no account and no server-side processing. There is no remote MCP server — the manifest below is descriptive.

## Agent surface
- Tool index: https://privacyfold.com/tools.json
- MCP manifest (descriptive, transport: none): https://privacyfold.com/.well-known/mcp.json
- JSON-LD schemas: https://privacyfold.com/schemas/_index.json
- Changelog: https://privacyfold.com/changelog.json
- Agent URL contract: https://privacyfold.com/tools/{slug}/?mode=agent&preset={presetSlug}#payload
  (sensitive payloads go in the #fragment, which browsers never send to a server; there is no server)

## Tools (72)
- **ADA & WCAG PDF accessibility checker** (`ada_pdf`): Check document structure against US ADA Title II/III, Section 508, and PDF/UA (ISO 14289) accessibility rules: document title, language tag, heading nesting, and image alt attributes.
  - Task: Audit document heading hierarchy, alt text & reading order for ADA compliance
  - Accepts: pdf
  - Standard: ISO 32000-1 (PDF 1.7) via pdf-lib
  - Engine: Plain JavaScript in your browser (no engine binary)
  - URL: https://privacyfold.com/tools/ada-pdf/
- **AI Airlock (PII redactor & token restorer)** (`ai_airlock`): Detect personal data (names, emails, SSN/NINO, IBAN, credit cards, phones, API keys) on your device, replace them with tokens ([PERSON_1], [EMAIL_1]) before pasting into ChatGPT/Claude, and restore real values locally afterwards.
  - Task: Sanitize personal data before prompting cloud AI, then restore locally
  - Accepts: text
  - Standard: ECMAScript (any modern browser)
  - Engine: Plain JavaScript in your browser (no engine binary)
  - URL: https://privacyfold.com/tools/ai-airlock/
- **Rewriter (rule-based)** (`ai_writer`): Tightens wordy phrases, converts prose to bullets, formalises or simplifies it with a fixed rule set. Deterministic: the same text always gives the same output, nothing is sent to a model, and no download is needed.
  - Task: Tighten or restyle your writing
  - Accepts: text
  - Standard: ECMAScript (any modern browser)
  - Engine: Plain JavaScript in your browser (no engine binary)
  - URL: https://privacyfold.com/tools/ai-writer/
- **API request converter (cURL ↔ fetch ↔ axios)** (`api_builder`): Convert `curl` CLI requests (including headers, bearer tokens, and JSON bodies) into clean JavaScript `fetch()` or `axios` snippets without pasting private API keys into online converters.
  - Task: Convert cURL commands into JavaScript fetch() or Axios code locally
  - Accepts: text
  - Standard: ECMAScript (any modern browser)
  - Engine: Plain JavaScript in your browser (no engine binary)
  - URL: https://privacyfold.com/tools/api-builder/

- **Background remover (flat backgrounds)** (`bg_remove`): Flood-fills the border colour from the edges and makes it transparent, with a tolerance slider. Built for studio, product and document shots on a plain background — it is a colour-key cutout, not an AI matting model, and it will not trace hair.
  - Task: Remove a flat background
  - Accepts: image
  - Standard: W3C HTML Canvas 2D

  - URL: https://privacyfold.com/tools/bg-remove/
- **Chat with a document** (`chat_pdf`): Split pasted document text into passages, rank them against your question with BM25 keyword scoring, and quote the best passages with the score that found them. Retrieval is deterministic: you can see why a passage was chosen, and the answer is quoted rather than generated.
  - Task: Answer questions from document text with local keyword retrieval

  - URL: https://privacyfold.com/tools/chat-pdf/
- **Smart clipboard & tracking scrubber** (`clean_paste`): When you copy and paste links or text from modern web pages, social media platforms, or marketing emails, tracking entities secretly embed surveillance markers into your clipboard. These include UTM campaign tags, Facebook click IDs (fbclid), Google click IDs (gclid), affiliate tracking tokens, and invisible zero-width unicode characters (such as zero-width spaces U+200B and word joiners U+2060) that can fingerprint your specific user account across applications. PrivacyFold's Smart Clipboard & Tracking Scrubber sanitizes copied links and prose entirely in client-side memory. It strips surveillance parameters, normalizes obfuscated characters, and emits pristine, privacy-clean text with zero tracking leakage.
  - Task: Clean tracking tokens, UTM tags, and zero-width tracking characters from copied text
  - Accepts: text
  - Standard: ECMAScript (any modern browser)
  - Engine: Plain JavaScript in your browser (no engine binary)
  - URL: https://privacyfold.com/tools/clean-paste/
- **HTML / CSS / JS minifier & entity codec** (`code_minifier`): Minify CSS, HTML, or JavaScript snippets by stripping comments and collapsing whitespace, or encode/decode HTML entities (`&amp;`, `&lt;`, `&gt;`).

  - Accepts: text
  - Standard: ECMAScript (any modern browser)

  - URL: https://privacyfold.com/tools/code-minifier/

- **Email header & SPF/DKIM/DMARC analyzer** (`email_header`): Paste raw email headers (`Received`, `Authentication-Results`, `Return-Path`) to trace server hops and verify SPF, DKIM, and DMARC status without uploading confidential emails to MXToolbox.

  - URL: https://privacyfold.com/tools/email-header/
- **Photo metadata & location remover** (`exif_strip`): Digital photos captured by modern smartphones and digital cameras embed invisible Exchangeable Image File Format (EXIF) metadata inside every file. This metadata frequently contains precise GPS latitude and longitude coordinates showing the exact location of your home, office, or children's school, along with camera serial numbers, device model, capture timestamps, exposure settings, and embedded thumbnail images. PrivacyFold's Photo Metadata Remover inspects the raw binary byte stream of your image directly in browser memory, parsing standard JPEG APP1 segments, PNG tEXt/eXIf chunks, and WebP EXIF containers, surgically eliminating every tracking marker before re-encoding or exporting the clean image. Zero bytes are uploaded to remote cloud servers, preserving total confidentiality.
  - Task: Remove EXIF, GPS location, and camera serial metadata from photos
  - Accepts: image
  - Standard: W3C HTML Canvas 2D + File API
  - Engine: Plain JavaScript in your browser (no engine binary)
  - URL: https://privacyfold.com/tools/exif-strip/
- **Exposure X-ray & redaction self-test** (`exposure_xray`): Drop any photo, PDF, or text snippet to see what it gives away: GPS pins, camera serials, timestamps, author history, and hidden PDF text layers—plus a Redaction Self-Test proving 0 hidden words are recoverable.
  - Task: See everything a file reveals before you share it
  - Accepts: any
  - Standard: ECMAScript (any modern browser)
  - Engine: Plain JavaScript in your browser (no engine binary)
  - URL: https://privacyfold.com/tools/exposure-xray/
- **Zero-knowledge file encryptor & self-decrypting envelope** (`file_encrypt`): When sharing sensitive financial statements, tax filings, legal contracts, or confidential identity documents, traditional cloud file-sharing services store your data unencrypted on their servers or hold the master decryption keys. PrivacyFold's Zero-Knowledge File Encryptor implements military-grade AES-256-GCM symmetric encryption combined with PBKDF2 key derivation using 600,000 SHA-256 iterations directly inside your browser via the W3C Web Cryptography API. Rather than requiring recipients to install proprietary decryption software, the tool packages your encrypted payload into a self-decrypting HTML envelope. Any recipient with the correct passphrase can open the HTML file in any modern web browser on Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, or Android, enter the password, and decrypt the original file with zero software installations and zero network requests.
  - Task: Encrypt sensitive files with AES-256-GCM into self-contained HTML envelopes that decrypt offline
  - Accepts: any
  - Standard: ECMAScript (any modern browser)
  - Engine: Plain JavaScript in your browser (no engine binary)
  - URL: https://privacyfold.com/tools/file-encrypt/
- **Hash generator** (`hash_gen`): Create a SHA fingerprint of text or any file, to check that it has not changed.
  - Task: Get a file fingerprint (hash)
  - Accepts: any
  - Standard: ECMAScript (any modern browser)
  - Engine: Plain JavaScript in your browser (no engine binary)
  - URL: https://privacyfold.com/tools/hash-gen/

- **Client-side image compressor** (`image_compress`): Image compression is one of the most common file processing tasks on the web, yet virtually every existing online compression service forces users to transmit personal photos, business graphics, and sensitive scanned documents to remote cloud infrastructure. PrivacyFold's Client-Side Image Compressor re-engineers modern production-grade compression algorithms—including Mozilla's MozJPEG, Google's WebP, libpng, and AVIF—compiled directly into WebAssembly. This architecture enables industrial-strength compression with intelligent perceptual quantization, color subsampling, and binary size targeting to run entirely within your local browser sandbox. You can compress images to exact kilobyte limits (e.g. under 200 KB for portal forms) with zero server bills, zero bandwidth consumption, and guaranteed zero privacy leakage.
  - Task: Compress JPEG, PNG, and WebP images to exact target file sizes without quality loss
  - Accepts: image
  - Standard: W3C HTML Canvas 2D + File API
  - Engine: Plain JavaScript in your browser (no engine binary)
  - URL: https://privacyfold.com/tools/image-compress/

  - Task: Upscale an image 2× to 4×

- **Fill fields from scanned text** (`ocr_scan`): Map the text layer of a scanned document — pasted in, or copied out of any OCR app — onto W-9 / SA100 style fields. Labelled lines such as "Name: …" are matched deterministically and shown with the line they came from, so a wrong guess is visible. No OCR model ships with this tool, and nothing is invented from pixels.

- **Biometric passport photo creator** (`passport_photo`): Applying for international passports, travel visas, permanent residency cards, and national identity credentials requires strict adherence to sovereign biometric photo specifications. Government portals routinely reject user uploads for minor non-compliance issues such as incorrect face-to-frame height ratios, non-compliant background luminance, improper head tilt, incorrect millimeter dimensions, or excessive file sizes. PrivacyFold's Biometric Passport Photo Creator provides an automated, client-side photographic studio directly in your browser. It includes pre-calibrated presets for over 87 international jurisdictions (including US State Department 2x2 inch, UK HM Passport Office 35x45mm, Schengen ICAO, Canada IRCC, Australia ImmiAccount, and UAE Golden Visa), allowing you to frame, crop, calibrate background lighting, and export print-ready 600 DPI sheets with absolute privacy and zero server uploads.
  - Task: Crop and standardize biometric ID and passport photos to official government dimensions
  - Accepts: image
  - Standard: W3C HTML Canvas 2D + EXIF 2.32
  - Engine: Plain JavaScript in your browser (no engine binary)
  - URL: https://privacyfold.com/tools/passport-photo/

- **Private PDF merger & binder** (`pdf_merge`): Combining confidential documents—such as tax returns, bank statements, employment verifications, and medical records—is a standard administrative requirement for visa, loan, mortgage, and legal applications. However, standard online PDF merge websites require you to upload your sensitive multi-page documents to their remote servers, exposing private financial and personal identity records to server log retention and potential cloud data breaches. PrivacyFold's Private PDF Merger combines, reorders, and binds PDF files entirely within your web browser's client-side memory using WebAssembly and pure client-side PDF object streaming. Your original PDFs never leave your machine, ensuring full compliance with HIPAA, GDPR, attorney-client privilege, and enterprise confidentiality requirements.
  - Task: Combine multiple PDF documents into a single organized file in browser memory
  - Accepts: pdf
  - Standard: ISO 32000-1 (PDF 1.7) via pdf-lib
  - Engine: Plain JavaScript in your browser (no engine binary)
  - URL: https://privacyfold.com/tools/pdf-merge/

- **Destructive PDF redactor & blackout tool** (`pdf_redact`): Redacting sensitive information from legal filings, government FOIA requests, and corporate contracts requires true destructive removal of underlying data. A notorious failure mode in digital redaction involves placing black rectangles over sensitive text without deleting the underlying text stream—allowing anyone to select, copy, or search the hidden Social Security Numbers, names, or financial figures underneath. PrivacyFold's Destructive PDF Redactor permanently removes both the visual elements and the underlying content stream objects, vector paths, and metadata from the document structure. Running 100% locally in your browser, it ensures that classified and private information is mathematically eradicated before the document ever leaves your workstation.
  - Task: Permanently blackout and erase sensitive text, SSNs, and figures from PDF files
  - Accepts: pdf
  - Standard: ISO 32000-1 (PDF 1.7) via pdf-lib
  - Engine: Plain JavaScript in your browser (no engine binary)
  - URL: https://privacyfold.com/tools/pdf-redact/
